CORE SURVIVES, PROPOSED EDIT IS OVERSTATED AND FAILS THE INCLUSION TEST IN TWO PLACES.

WHAT I CONFIRMED (verifying in both directions, and logging the confirmation explicitly). The finding's factual premise about the target file holds on direct reading. Dossier line 116 says "the parents' divorce filing" — singular. Line 118 calls it "a clerical error in a divorce petition" and grades probative value "near zero." Register row 2 (line 157) says "Nov. 22 (Owens, citing divorce filing)" — singular again. And the understatement propagates a third time, which the finding did not catch: the Bottom-line synthesis at line 185 lists "birthday clerical variance" among items of "negligible probative weight." I ran a null battery over the dossier with patterns capable of matching a multiplicity acknowledgment — "nine" (0), "eight" (0), "recur" (0), "filings" (3, all patent/corporate), "documents" (3, all the Tier-4 label), "decade" (1, Lori's GE tenure), "BOC-E0\d" (0). Both files are clean UTF-8, zero NUL and zero U+FFFE, so grep is reliable here and artifact_search.py's dual-reading requirement does not bite. The dossier nowhere acknowledges multiplicity and cross-references no BOC file at all. The understatement is real and material. There is also a clean causal explanation supporting the finding: the dossier's only birthdate citation is US Weekly's Feb. 26, 2026 recap of Ep. 1, and BOC-E01 §4.3 does describe the claim in the plural-but-vague "1998 divorce filings," while BOC-E03 line 47 shows the document set growing by crowdsourcing before Ep. 4's walkthrough. The dossier was built from Ep. 1 coverage and never updated.

WHY THE PROPOSED EDIT MUST NOT BE ADOPTED AS WRITTEN.

(1) THE COUNT IS WRONG, AND IT IS WRONG IN THE DIRECTION THAT INFLATES THE CLAIM. I parsed the §5 table programmatically rather than trusting any self-count. Nine documents are walked through, but only EIGHT carry a claimed Nov 22, 1988 entry. Row 5 (amendment to child support plan) has "—" in the DOB column. The proposed edit says "nine displayed documents ... each, she says, carrying Nov 22, 1988" — and then enumerates only eight, silently dropping row 5, which is precisely the one that does not carry the date. So the edit asserts nine-for-nine while listing eight. BOC-E04's own Open Item 1 ("the nine-document Nov 22 pattern") is the source of the error; the finding inherited a self-count instead of recounting, which is the exact hazard the standing rules name. Independent cross-check: BOC-E03 line 47 records Owens saying a viewer sent "all the remaining documents (~6 total; she'd had 2)" — 2 + 6 = 8 Nov-22-bearing documents. Two sources converge on eight.

(2) STAKES LENS — THE EDIT IMPORTS PRIVATE-FAMILY DOCKET DETAIL THAT IS FAITHFUL TO ITS SOURCE AND STILL DOES NOT BELONG. This is the inclusion-test-is-not-the-accuracy-test distinction. The edit's itemized catalogue — "a 2004 child-support default recording," "a 2007 emancipation filing," "a Jan 1999 medical child support order," "two separation agreements," "a hand-filled joint shared parenting plan" — is an inventory of two private individuals' domestic-relations file. The child-support-default item is the sharpest failure: BOC-E04 row 8 makes the attribution explicit ("Kent defaulted July 2004"), so the edit conveys a derogatory financial allegation against a man the dossier itself describes at line 51 as having "essentially no mainstream press profile," sourced entirely to anonymous-provenance, screen-displayed, third-party-unauthenticated reproductions at Tier 4. It bears on nothing the entry exists to test. Only two facts are load-bearing for the correction: that the claim rests on multiple documents rather than one, and that they span roughly a decade. Everything past that is scope-widening. Note that the edit's omission of row 5 is itself protective — row 5 is where Owens insinuates the Kent and Lori signatures were forged — so the fix is not to restore row 5 but to stop itemizing and cite BOC-E04 §5 by reference.

(3) "STRONGEST DOCUMENTARY ANOMALY IN OWENS' SERIES" UPGRADES THE SOURCE. BOC-E04 §5 says "the FIRST claim in the series that would survive contact with a mundane-error explanation in its strong form." First is not strongest. The upgrade also collides with the dossier's own line 127, which calls Claim 4 (the never-dated framing) "the best-evidenced discrepancy in the register" precisely because its counter-evidence is contemporaneous primary material rather than unauthenticated reproductions. Adopting "strongest" would create a fresh internal contradiction.

(4) THE HAMILTON COUNTY INSTRUCTION WOULD COMMIT THE CARDINAL ERROR. The venue is not established. BOC-E01 Open Item 1 identifies it "per Owens' own Ep 5 reading of the documents"; BOC-E04 Open Item 1 says "Hamilton County, OH probable ... confirm." That is a claimant-derived, unverified venue. Writing it into the dossier's register as the resolution path would promote it to analyst-layer fact by inheritance — the V-10 lesson exactly. Worse, it would contradict the dossier's own Register #1 and Open Item 2, which route the Good Samaritan birth-announcement trace to the DAYTON Daily News (Montgomery County), while BOC-E01 line 139 records Ep. 1 placing the birth at a Good Samaritan in PHOENIX. Three candidate Good Samaritans are live in this library. The venue may be named only as reported-and-unconfirmed, with that tension flagged.

(5) MINOR — DROP THE "Erica" DETAIL. It adds nothing to a birthdate assessment and it is transcript-fragile: a machine transcript of Owens speaking cannot distinguish "Erika" from "Erica," and BOC-E04 §1 expressly normalizes proper-noun garbles. Not a hard failure, but unnecessary insinuation about a living person resting on an access path that by construction cannot carry it.

TERMINOLOGY. The finding says register entry #2 "is resolved as a one-off clerical error." The file does not resolve it — it grades it "unverified, low-significance even if true." The defect is a dismissive significance grade attached to an understated claim, not a false resolution. That distinction matters under this project's narrow-resolution standard.

REFUTED AS STATED, though a real core survives. I opened every cited primary and read around each quote.

WHAT VERIFIES (logged as confirmation, per verify-in-both-directions):
1. The target text exists at lines 31, 34, 78 — the finding is not aimed at absent text.
2. The booking record, rendered per instruction (pdftoppm -r 300 -png; the .txt is garble and was not used), reads exactly: "Arrested: 09/12/2025 | 04:00:00 AM" / "Arresting Agency: Other" / "Booked: 09/12/2025 | 07:58:15 AM" / "Booking No: 460956", with three charge blocks each "4th District Court / Case # 251403576" (court+county satisfied).
3. The affidavit's face carries "On 09/12/2025 04:00 the defendant was arrested…" and, in its submission block, "Arrest Date/Time: 09/12/2025 04:00", plus "Probable Cause Entered: 09/12/2025 07:18" and "Agency Inmate ID: 460956".
4. The day3 transcript quotes are verbatim accurate. The finding actually UNDERSTATES its best evidence: at Rev offset 39:59 Davis says outright "It would've been September 12th. It was about 4:00 AM, I believe" — a quote the finding never cites. Content-based speaker inference confirms the Rev labels here (the questioner moves exhibits into evidence and is answered by "Agent Davis"; Novak lodges standing objections), so the labels are corroborated, not relied on.
5. Uncited corroboration I found: Davis testified he got the call ~8:30 PM Sept 11, landed at St. George ~11:30 PM, and reached WCSO "close to midnight… of the 11th" — so a 10 p.m. Sept 11 arrest *performed by Davis* (as the Prospect's sheet is said to state) is impossible on his own sworn account. The bail order was signed 08:40:00 AM Sept 12, 42 minutes after the 07:58:15 booking.
6. Null, run through artifact_search.find() under BOTH the join and hyphen readings: pattern r'1:?58\s*(a\.?m|AM)' returns ZERO across all banked artifacts and all five transcripts. Capability control: the same pattern matches a synthetic "booked at 1:58 a.m. … 1:58 AM" string, so it can reach the thing claimed absent. Per-term contamination note: the BAM Franchising mis-bank produced 14 false hits on the stem "758" (Bates numbers, timestamps) and so is excluded FOR THAT TERM ONLY; it produced no hits on "1:58", "10:00 PM", or "Arrest Date/Time", so no exclusion was applied there.

So the booking half is sound: "1:58 a.m." is contradicted, and 07:58:15 / "about 8:00 AM" / arrival ~7:00 AM is documented.

WHY IT IS REFUTED AS STATED:

A. THE 10 P.M. FIGURE IS NOT CONTRADICTED — IT IS A NAMED OFFICIAL'S CUSTODY TIME. Searching the corpus for the figure the finding wants deleted hit the arrest-announcement press conference. FBI Director Kash Patel, on the record: "just last night, the suspect was taken into custody at 10 PM local time. In less than 36 hours, 33 to be precise…" That is Tier 2, and the "33 hours" the file already records at line 43 is arithmetically derived from it (12:23 p.m. Sept 10 → 10 p.m. Sept 11 = 33.6 h). My lens flagged the other hit correctly: the second "10:00 P.M." in that transcript is inside a reporter's question premise ("the timeline that Director Patel gave us, led to the arrest at 10:00 P.M."), which Cox declined to adopt — but Patel's own statement is not a premise, it is the source. The file's line 31 mis-sources the 10 p.m. to the booking sheet; the fix is to re-source it, not to delete it.

B. A TIER 1 FILING PLACES THE SURRENDER ON THE EVENING OF SEPTEMBER 11. The Information's probable-cause statement — authored by Davis — reads: "Over the next approximately 33 hours, police conducted a manhunt for the shooter until the evening of September 11, 2025, when Tyler James Robinson surrendered to police at the Washington County Sheriff's Office." So "the real chain is … all on Sept 12" erases the State's own T1 characterization. There is no contradiction to resolve: Davis's testimony itself draws the distinction the file already hypothesised — "was Mr. Robinson detained at that time?" "Yes, he was"; "was he formally arrested at that time?" "After all the interviews were completed…". Custody Sept 11 evening, formal arrest 04:00 Sept 12. The finding treats a definitional difference as a factual conflict and then "resolves" it by deleting the correct half.

C. THE §5 ITEM 1 AMENDMENT IS CONTRADICTED BY THAT SAME T1 FILING, and is the most damaging part of the proposal. It asserts the premise "the arrest process spanned midnight" is "now false" and that "the evening of his arrest" therefore determinately means Sept 12. The process did span midnight — arrival ~9 p.m. Sept 11, detention overnight, formal arrest 04:00 — and the State's own filing calls the surrender an evening-of-Sept-11 event. Applying this amendment would narrow the file's live open question toward a benign reading on a premise the primaries refute.

D. "FOUR INDEPENDENT PRIMARIES" FAILS ON BOTH COUNT AND INDEPENDENCE. There are three documents (UCSO inmate record, affidavit, transcript), not four. Worse, they are not independent: Agency Inmate ID 460956 = Booking No 460956, the same booking; Davis is the affiant, is recited in the bail order as "the affirmation of Brian Davis, the arresting officer", and testified "I was the booking officer… I filled out the necessary paperwork… the probable cause statement, and then it's signed and submitted." Every arrest-time datum traces to one man's data entry. That is the "syndicated recaps are one source, not many" error moved from outlets to documents, and it would inflate the grade.

E. THE LOCATOR IS WRONG AND WOULD READ AS FABRICATION. .txt line 140 does not say "Arrest Date/Time: 09/12/2025 04:00"; it reads "Arrest Date/Time: NONE" — the untagged extraction scrambled the two-column footer. The value appears only in a -layout render (line 151). An editor following the locator would find "NONE".

F. THE PROPOSED §2 PROSE ASSERTS SOMETHING THE CITED TRANSCRIPT DOES NOT SAY. It has Robinson "detained… and interviewed, along with his parents and the family friend, by SBI and FBI agents." Davis enumerated interviews of the mother, the father and the family friend only; of Robinson he said merely "We obtained his name and date of birth." Analyst-layer assertion beyond the source. The "~9 p.m." in the same header is also hearsay within testimony — "I was told he arrived there about 9:00 PM."

COLLATERAL ERROR FOUND WHILE READING (not part of the finding, but it bears on how much weight this testimony can carry): §7 says "only the investigators' account (Hull, Davis) has been tested under oath and on cross-examination." Davis was never cross-examined — Novak: "No cross-examination for Agent Davis" (day4, 03:19:52), and Davis was excused with none. Hull was crossed by Nestor on day 2; Davis was not. Fix §7 as to Davis.

verdicts.reason:
The finding's substance is half right, but its headline claim fails against the primary record, and its proposed edit would delete a Tier-2 official statement from the recording layer.

1. THE 10 P.M. FIGURE IS NOT THE BOOKING SHEET'S — IT IS FBI DIRECTOR PATEL'S, IN A DOCUMENT THIS PROJECT HOLDS. The finding never opened the Sept. 12, 2025 arrest-announcement transcript (2026-08-16_rev_fbi-captures-kirk-shooter.txt), which the coordinator listed as a held primary for this very chronology. Patel, in his own voice: "just last night, the suspect was taken into custody at 10 PM local time. In less than 36 hours, 33 to be precise... the suspect was apprehended." He says "local time," and his own anchor ("Charlie was shot at 12:23 PM on Wednesday") cross-validates it: 12:23 p.m. Sept 10 → 10 p.m. Sept 11 = 33.62 h, matching "33 to be precise." The 4:00 a.m. reading would be 39.62 h. Speaker confirmed by content, not label ("At my direction, the FBI released...", "Myself and Deputy Director Bongino"). Brooksby's "33-hour manhunt framing" (memo line 42) rests on the same endpoint.

2. THE FINDING MISREADS LINE 31. Line 31 reads "**~10 p.m.** — The publicly cited custody time." — then adds the booking sheet as a corroborating artifact. The memo does not "rest on" the sheet for this figure; the sheet corroborates a separately, correctly attributed public figure. The proposed edit would strike the entry and label it "carried... from a third-party-posted booking sheet is superseded," misattributing the provenance and removing a named official's statement because the analyst layer disagrees with it — an inversion of the prime directive. Patel's claim must stay, attributed.

3. "THE CONFLICT WAS NEVER INSIDE THE RECORD" IS FALSE. It is squarely inside: Patel (T2, 2025-09-12, held) says custody at 10 p.m. Sept 11; Davis (T1 sworn) says formal arrest ~04:00 Sept 12. Both are held. Davis himself supplies the reconciliation the memo had already hypothesized: he affirms Robinson was "detained" at WCSO on arrival (day3 39:22) and that "after all the interviews were completed... he was formally arrested at that time" (39:28). Custody ~10 p.m. → formal arrest ~4 a.m. is coherent, not contradictory. Discrepancy #2's own hedge ("could in principle reflect custody-vs-formal-arrest distinctions") was correct.

4. THE PROPOSED MECHANISM IS REFUTED BY ARITHMETIC. "'1:58' is most economically explained as a misreading of '7:58'" cannot survive: the memo's two figures sit exactly −6:00 from the held record's two fields (22:00→04:00:00 = 6:00:00; 01:58→07:58:15 = 6:00:15, i.e. exact to the minute), and the arrest→booking interval is identical in both chains (3h58m vs 3h58m15s). A digit misreading cannot produce a uniform shift in a different field. Six hours is the MDT (UTC−6) offset. So the sheet's booking figure is a systematic offset artifact, not a misread digit — and the 10 p.m. figure needs no such explanation at all, since Patel states it independently.

5. "THREE HELD RECORDS" OVERSTATES INDEPENDENCE. The affidavit, the jail record and the testimony all originate with Brian Davis — affiant, arresting-scene agent, and self-described booking officer who "filled out the necessary paperwork... and then it's signed and submitted to the system" (day3 47:05). The affidavit's Agency Inmate ID 460956 is the web record's Booking No 460956: two views of one booking record. One source in three instantiations, not three confirmations.

6. "THIS IS THE WHOLE OF DISCREPANCY #2" IS FALSE ON THE FILE'S FACE. Line 78 also carries Brooksby's "driven to Utah County by about 2 a.m." — irreconcilable with a 4 a.m. formal arrest at WCSO and a ~7 a.m. jail arrival — plus the reporters'-paraphrase caveat. The proposed edit concedes this ("should be re-graded or dropped") while simultaneously marking #2 "RESOLVED." #2 narrows; it does not close.

7. AUDIT RAN ONE DIRECTION. Line 31's other two booking-sheet elements verify TRUE against Davis's sworn testimony: arrest "by SBI agent Brian Davis" (affidavit: "UTBDAVIS - Brian Davis / UT018015A - Attorney General") and "location outside Utah County" (Davis, day3 39:45: "At the Washington County Sheriff's Office"). The finding cites these fields only as grounds for doubt. Per BOC-AUDIT 5.2 these confirmations must be logged.

8. WEAKER LOCATOR THAN AVAILABLE. The finding cites day3 45:30, which is Hunt's leading recap ("you stated that...") adopted by "Yes, that's correct." Davis's own first-person statement is at day3 39:59: "It would've been September 12th. It was about 4:00 AM, I believe, of September 12th." Use that.

Its PDF metadata is "Screenshot 2026-03-15 044204 / Producer: Microsoft Print To PDF / Author: Enri" — an unauthenticated third-party screenshot of the UCSO public inmate page, i.e. the same species of artifact as the Crowder-provenance sheet it is offered to supersede; "T2 by capture path" is too generous. Null battery run through artifact_search.py (both readings) across 72 banked .txt artifacts: "09/11/2025", "\b09112025\b" and a ten-p.m.-in-words pattern all NULL; "the defendant was arrested" matched only the affidavit, confirming the battery could reach what was claimed absent. CORE SURVIVES, THREE LOAD-BEARING SUB-CLAIMS REFUTED, AND THE EDIT CANNOT BE APPLIED AS DRAFTED.

WHAT I CONFIRMED (logged explicitly, both directions).
1. The file really does say what the finding quotes. Lines 31, 34, 78 match verbatim.
2. The booking record's two clock times are exactly as the finding reports. Rendered page 1 at 300 dpi (pdftoppm -r 300, crop -x 1000 -y 200): "Arrested: 09/12/2025 | 04:00:00 AM" · "Arresting Agency: Other" · "Booked: 09/12/2025 | 07:58:15 AM" · "Booking No: 460956". The degraded text layer ("Aree 09122025 040000", "Soket: 0912720751758 1500") was NOT relied on.
3. Day 3 quotes at 36:51 and 46:49 are verbatim in the banked transcript.
4. The finding UNDERSELLS its own best evidence: it cites day3 45:30, which is counsel's leading recap ("you stated that he was arrested in the early hours of September 12th"). The direct testimony is at 39:45/39:59 — Q "Where did the arrest take place?" A "At the Washington County Sheriff's Office." / "It would've been September 12th. It was about 4:00 AM, I believe." Use that instead.
5. An independent confirmation the finding missed: Davis testified he got the call ~8:30 p.m., flew down, "landed probably about 11:30 PM at the St. George Airport" (34:45) and reached WCSO "just a little bit before midnight" (35:40). He therefore could not have effected a 10:00 p.m. Sept. 11 arrest as the Prospect's sheet is described. That is the strongest support for the finding, and it is not in it.
6. A second confirmation: the affidavit's "Agency Inmate ID: 460956" is the inmate page's "Booking No: 460956" — one Utah County booking exists for this arrest, so there was no separate 1:58 a.m. Utah County booking.

REFUTED SUB-CLAIM 1 — THE "SIGNATURE LINE" IS A TEXT-LAYER ARTIFACT, NOT A SECOND ATTESTATION. The finding asserts: signature line "/S/ Davis, Brian 09/12/2025 04:00". I rendered affidavit page 3 at 300 dpi. On the FACE, "/S/ Davis, Brian" carries NO timestamp. The 04:00 sits below a double rule as the value of "Arrest Date/Time:" inside the "SUBMISSION IDENTIFICATION INFORMATION" block, and the signature block's own timestamp is "Probable Cause Entered: 09/12/2025 07:18". The finding read the reflowed text layer, not the face — the exact F-39 hazard the brief warned of. This matters because it inflates the corroboration count: it converts one data field into an apparent second, sworn attestation. CR-E08 has ALREADY been corrected once for mislabeling this same footer block (v1.0 called "Probable Cause Entered" a "submission timestamp"); this repeats a corrected error class in the same library.

REFUTED SUB-CLAIM 2 — "THREE HELD RECORDS AGREE" IS FALSE; ALL THREE TRACE TO ONE OFFICER. The affidavit's header line ("On 09/12/2025 04:00 the defendant was arrested") is the same Arrest Date/Time field rendered twice by the form. The jail page's "Arrested: 04:00:00" is that field as received by the jail system — Davis testified he WAS the booking officer and "filled out the necessary paperwork essentially with the jail... the probable cause statement, and then it's signed and submitted to the system" (47:05), and the matching 460956 identifier proves the link. So there is ONE datum entered by Brian Davis, appearing in two derived views, plus Brian Davis's own hedged testimony ("about 4:00 AM, I believe"). Counting that as three agreeing records is precisely the repetition-is-not-corroboration error the project's own rule forbids. "Confidence: High" is right for "4:00 a.m. is the record's official figure"; it is not earned for "4:00 a.m. is independently corroborated."

REFUTED SUB-CLAIM 3 — "THIS IS THE WHOLE OF DISCREPANCY #2" IS CONTRADICTED BY THE FINDING'S OWN TEXT. Discrepancy #2 also carries Brooksby's "driven to Utah County by about 2 a.m.," and the proposed edit concedes that this remains contradicted by Davis's ~7 a.m. arrival and "should be re-graded or dropped." A residual live conflict is not "the whole of" a resolved item. Relatedly, "the conflict was never inside the record" is false on the edit's own next sentence: Brooksby is a named official (T2) inside the record.

MY LENS — STAKES. Two problems, one of them disqualifying as drafted.
(a) "No formal arrest occurs here" (proposed line 31) claims MORE than the source carries about a living, unadjudicated capital defendant, and suppresses the sworn answer that cuts the other way. Day3 39:16–39:28: Q "was Mr. Robinson detained at that time?" A "Yes, he was." Q "Was he formally arrested at that time?" A "Yeah. After all the interviews were completed..." Robinson was DETAINED at WCSO from arrival; only the formal arrest waited until ~4 a.m. When custody began is the precise question discrepancy #1 (the 6:25 p.m. Miranda transcript) turns on, and it is a contested legal question this project must not settle by adjective. Write the record's own two terms — "detained" and "formally arrested" — and assert nothing beyond them.
(b) INCLUSION TEST, NOT ACCURACY TEST — the finding creates a live PII pressure it does not guard. Adopting day3.txt as a cited primary sends the next pass to lines that name the family friend in full (37:56, 39:05) — a private individual the file currently identifies by role and surname only — and to Affidavit p.1, which carries the defendant's DOB and a residential street address. Both are perfectly faithful to their sources and neither belongs in this file. §3's current wording, "no fuller name published in reviewed reporting," is now falsified by a held source and reads as an invitation to complete it. The edit must not land without an explicit guard and that rewording. Note also day3 47:37, where the prosecutor expressly instructed the witness not to give exact addresses.
(c) SCOPE: no widening. The added material (Davis's travel, arrival, booking) is squarely within the memo's public question. Nothing touches the Public Safety Assessment. Confirmed clean.

PROVENANCE SYMMETRY — A BIAS SIGNAL. The finding grades the held inmate record "T2 by capture path" while faulting the Prospect's sheet for third-party provenance. pdfinfo on the held artifact: Title "Screenshot 2026-03-15 044204", Author "Enri", Producer "Microsoft: Print To PDF", created 2026-03-15 — an unauthenticated third-party screen capture of a public agency page, taken six months after booking. That is the SAME provenance class as the sheet it supersedes. Grade it honestly and say so, or the audit trail only ever moves one way.

CONJECTURE MISLABELED AS RESOLUTION. Bolding "'1:58' is most economically explained as a misreading of '7:58'" fails its own economy test: it explains one figure and leaves the 10 p.m. figure unexplained, and the sheet is described as carrying an arresting-officer name and a location field that the held page does not have. Record it as an untested conjecture; do not bold it as a finding.

EDIT DEFECTS. (i) The proposed line 31 duplicates line 30 — the file already has "Just before 9 p.m. — Robinson arrives at the WCSO office in Hurricane with his parents and the family friend." Two consecutive ~9 p.m. arrival bullets. (ii) It also files Davis's 11:30 p.m. landing under a ~9 p.m. heading. (iii) It is incomplete: lines 77, 102 and 127 all still run on the superseded figures ("the 10 p.m. booking-sheet arrest time"; "Inmate booking sheet — primary document... cited via the Prospect"; "booking times directly conflict between the booking sheet and reported testimony"). Applied as drafted, the file self-contradicts in three places.

VERDICT: not refuted — the memo's 10 p.m. / 1:58 a.m. figures are genuinely superseded by held primaries and by sworn testimony, and that correction should land. But it is materially overstated and must land in the narrower form below, with the living-persons guards attached.

RESIDUAL SCOPE — what I did NOT verify: the Prospect article itself (not held, not fetched); the NewsNation and ABC4 reports (not re-read; the finding's characterization of them is taken on its face); day1/2/4/5, cross-examination of Davis, and any later Day 3 testimony past 48:14; the WCSO custody/CAD log (does not exist in this library); whether a certified Day 3 transcript reads differently.

SURVIVES ON ITS CORE, BUT THE PROPOSED §0.3 CONTAINS TWO ERRORS THE SOURCE REFUTES OUTRIGHT.

WHAT VERIFIED (logged as confirmations, per verify-in-both-directions):

1. The quotes are verbatim. day4.txt line 6046 (offset 06:19:04) reads exactly "Ms. Kirk has been very adept at holding press conferences at which she has revealed evidence. She has represented that the State is her attorney." Neiman's answers are verbatim at line 6070 ("there was a lot that was just said that's just not true", 06:20:24) and line 6078 ("There's a completely distortion of reality that was just put forth.", 06:20:59). day5.txt line 2624 carries the Exhibit 12.1 ruling verbatim.

2. Speaker attribution holds ON CONTENT, not on the label. The court says "To defense, Mr. Burt" at line 6030 immediately before, and "Thank you, Mr. Burt" at line 6050 immediately after — the turn is bracketed. Content is defence advocacy (Estes, the protective order, witness availability, "our ability to call this witness"). CR-E16 line 112 identifies Michael N. Burt, admitted pro hac vice. Capacity is right: he was speaking as defence counsel opposing the victim's family's request.

3. Neiman's reply is characterised accurately and — importantly — not overclaimed. He denied access to the State's evidence and said "the State is the State"; he did NOT rebut the press-conference characterisation, and the proposed entry does not say he did.

4. The register gap is real. The dossier returns ZERO hits for "victim", "courtroom", "preliminary hearing", "Neiman", "Burt", "Provo", "Fourth District". Claims 1–9 trace to Owens, Project Constitution, viral posts and Tier 3 press. Nothing from any courtroom.

5. The "only of its class" claim survives a null battery with patterns CAPABLE of matching. Across all five transcripts I ran Erika | Erica | Ms.\s*Kirk | Mrs.\s*Kirk | widow | victim'?s?\s*representative | press\s*conferenc | Kirk family. Every other hit is the court's own recognition/admonition, the court's rulings, Novak's characterisation of her COUNSEL's briefing (day4 599–603), or defence deference ("we totally respect Ms. Kirk's position", day3 2712). Across the held filings the role-name sweep found only procedural references. The one new candidate — "Ms. Kirk" in the 2026-01-05 prosecutor's opposition to the disqualification motion — is an OCR/typo for MR. Kirk ("where Ms. Kirk was approximately seated when HE was shot"), a sightline measurement about the decedent, not a claim about Erika. CONTAMINATION CHECK, PER TERM: the BAM Franchising mis-banked file returns 0 for Erika, 0 for Kirk, 0 for Ms. Kirk, 0 for victim representative, 0 for Neiman, 0 for Burt — no exclusion needed for these terms. U+FFFE = 0 and NUL = 0 in all five transcripts and in the 07-08 notice, so the null holds identically under both readings.

WHAT THE SOURCE REFUTES IN THE PROPOSED EDIT:

A. "On 2026-07-10 the court ruled that Exhibit 12.1 be displayed" — WRONG DATE. The operative GRANT was Day 4, 2026-07-09, at day4.txt 9332 ("I will grant that request and that will be played in open court and we will watch the totality of… State's Exhibit 12.1") and 9340 and 9348, where the defence's continuing objection was expressly OVERRULED. Day 5 "adheres to its prior ruling" (2624) and adds the audio-only condition. Victim's counsel says so himself on Day 5 at 2608: "My understanding is you ruled yesterday that you were going to play it." This is the exact error CR-ACQ v1.8 already corrected and issued a standing rule against — "every library statement about 12.1's publication must date-stamp which ruling it describes." The proposed edit reintroduces the corrected error.

B. "The notice substantially succeeded, over defence objection" — REFUTED. The court ruled on the notice on Day 4 MORNING and largely DENIED it: "the court determines that not all exhibits will be visually displayed to the gallery"; "The court does not make a blanket ruling as it relates to any exhibit"; "And that concludes the court's ruling on that motion" (day4 303, 307, 311). The notice sought three orders — publish all previously unpublished admitted exhibits from days 1–3, display all future exhibits openly in real time, and receive no evidence concealed from those present. All three blanket forms were declined in favour of a tiered, exhibit-by-exhibit method. What later succeeded was a SEPARATE reconsideration motion Neiman moved that evening as to ONE exhibit (day4 6014–6018).

C. "Disposition: the argument did not prevail" — HALF WRONG. Burt's fallback ask was explicitly that the court "do it at the end of the process, and not at this point." The court did exactly that: "that will be played at the conclusion of defense's presentation of evidence" (9348). His opposition failed on the merits and PREVAILED on timing.

D. Tier marking. "T1 for utterance" is stated flat. The utterance is known only through a Rev machine transcript of the livestream — the same vendor whose labels this library distrusts and which garbles "Erica"/"Burke". The verbatim wording inside the quotation marks is ASR output. The project's own rule puts machine-transcript dependence in the access-path caveat, not silently at Tier 1.

E. Minor: "the family already had access to the evidence" overstates Burt, who said access to evidence "that the State has publicized" / "already in the public domain."

F. Minor: "closes" the CR-ACQ-2026-08-14B open item overstates. That file's line 47 already pointed at CR-ACQ §8 item 12, CLOSED 2026-08-01, which established the ruling. What is genuinely new is the link from the 07-08 notice to the Day-4-morning colloquy.

G. Scope word. "exists in the court record" should be "in the HELD court record" — the XChange export ends 2026-03-14, the 2026-02-02 Notice re Media Access is docketed but unheld, and the State's 2026-07-28 brief is unheld.

CONFIRMATIONS FIRST (verified in both directions, all read directly):
1. ✅ The absence is real. Part IV Claims 1–9 of the dossier trace without exception to Candace Owens, Project Constitution, aggregators, or T3 press; the file's only court-adjacent content is the Part III cease-and-desist paragraph (T3, Hollywood Reporter). No courtroom statement about her appears anywhere in the 239-line file.
2. ✅ Both Burt clauses are verbatim in day4.txt at stream offset 06:19:04. Neiman's "just not true" (06:20:24) and "a completely distortion of reality" (06:20:59) are verbatim. The Day 5 ruling text at 02:25:30 is verbatim.
3. ✅ Speaker attribution by content is sound — the court says "Thank you, Mr. Burt" at 06:20:15, immediately after.
4. ✅ "The State agreed … honours the victim representative's right to be present" is REAL and I had first doubted it: it is Christopher Ballard, Day 4 at offset 31:51 — not Grunander, whose "does not oppose … we favor openness and transparency" comes later at 06:17:43. The finding's paraphrase is faithful to Ballard.
5. ✅ "travelled to be present" is the notice's own heading language ("THE VICTIM'S FAMILY TRAVELED TO BEAR WITNESS"). §0.3 adds no identifying detail about Charlie Kirk's parents beyond role — the living-persons rule is NOT breached on that axis.
6. ✅ The defence did oppose (Novak 32:23; Burt 06:18:07; Ms. Nester's continuing objection 08:23:19).

NOW THE REFUTATION:

A. THE DISPOSITION IS BACKWARDS. §0.3 says "✅ The notice substantially succeeded." The court ruled on the notice on Day 4 morning at offsets 35:12–38:16 and DENIED its relief as requested: "the court determines that **not all exhibits will be visually displayed to the gallery**" and "**The court does not make a blanket ruling as it relates to any exhibit.**" All three prayers in ¶6 (a/b/c) were blanket orders; the court substituted a three-tier, exhibit-by-exhibit method (admit → display to gallery → publish to camera). What later succeeded was a separate, narrower reconsideration as to ONE exhibit.

B. THE DATE OF THE GRANT IS WRONG, AND CONTRADICTS A STANDING LIBRARY RULE. §0.3 says "On 2026-07-10 the court ruled that Exhibit 12.1 be displayed." The grant was 2026-07-09, day4.txt 08:21:46–08:23:24: "I will grant that request and it will be played in the courtroom for all present to see, but not to be broadcast on TV" — timing reserved. On 07-10 the court "adheres to its prior ruling" and added the audio-only mechanism. CR-ACQ-2026-07-27 v1.8 §8 item 12 already carries exactly this and orders that "every library statement about 12.1's publication must now be date-stamped."

C. THE "CLOSES THE OPEN ITEM" CLAIM CONFLATES TWO QUESTIONS. CR-ACQ-2026-08-14B line 47 asks how the court ruled ON THE NOTICE; the Exhibit 12.1 question was CLOSED 2026-08-01 (Q-11). The genuinely new material is the Day 4 morning ruling — and it runs against the finding.

D. SILENT TIER PROMOTION ON A REPUTATIONAL QUOTE. The entry marks the Burt utterance "(Tier 1, recording layer)" / "T1 for utterance." CR-E16's residual scope states plainly: "**The transcripts are commercial renderings, not certified.**" A nine-word accusation about a named living person's out-of-court conduct cannot be marked T1 off an uncertified ASR rendering — and the ASR is visibly degrading in this exact stretch ("there's no care", "a completely distortion of reality"). "She has represented that the State is her attorney" is grammatically anomalous and has the shape of a mangling; the proposed edit hard-quotes it and spawns a V-item around it.

E. UNSCOPED UNIVERSAL NEGATIVE, AND IT IS FALSE AS HEADLINED. "The only contested claim about Erika Kirk that exists in the court record" states no search scope and no access failures. Counter-instance in the same transcript: Ballard asserts the filing "honors the victim representative's right to be present" (31:51); Novak answers that "every order that this court has made to date complies with and respects the victim's rights" and that the 16-series exhibits do not "interfere with any of the enumerated rights" (32:23) — a contested claim about her rights and her position, on the record, that is not Burt's remark. And the held record has holes that are the most likely home for more: the 2026-02-02 "Notice re Media Access" is UNHELD (the library's own Q-66), the State's 2026-07-09 morning filing is unheld, and the XChange docket export stops at 2026-03-14.

F. INCLUSION TEST FAILS WHERE FIDELITY HOLDS. The dossier's scope (line 3) is claims about her BACKGROUND; Part IV is captioned "Contested biographical claims register ('the alleged lies')." Burt's remark is not biographical and is not an allegation of lying — it is a relevance/scheduling argument against replaying an exhibit while a defence witness was expiring. Docketing it as "Claim 10" in a register captioned "the alleged lies" re-frames a capital defendant's counsel's procedural advocacy as an accusation that the victim's widow lied. Robinson has NOT been bound over; lifting his counsel's argument out of its procedural setting into a conspiracy-narrative dossier misstates the defence's position and prejudices a living person on both sides.

G. SCOPE WIDENING AND MECHANICAL DEFECT. §0.3 is court-record material already carried by CR-ACQ §8 item 12, CR-E04 §3, CR-E06 and CR-ACQ-2026-08-14B; duplicating a ruling narrative into a biography dossier whose own bottom line says "Nothing in any tier of this material connects Erika Kirk to the evidence in Utah v. Robinson" creates a second, divergent account with no revision discipline. And the insertion target does not exist: the dossier has no "Part 0" — it opens at "## Part I".

SURVIVES IN CORE, REFUTED IN THREE SPECIFICS — and the proposed edit must not be applied as drafted.

I did not stop at the four cited outlets. Volokh linked the complaint, so I pulled it: Harpole v. Owens, No. 3:26-cv-00556 (M.D. Tenn., Nashville Div.), D.E. 1, 69 pp., free on RECAP (storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.tnmd.108994/gov.uscourts.tnmd.108994.1.0.pdf). Every page is stamped "Filed 04/30/26".

WHAT SURVIVES (verified against the primary):
1. The omission is real. In the dossier, "Huachuca", "Harpole", "Amodei", "Snow", "defamation", "lawsuit", "Tennessee", "Dallas", "Secret Service" all return 0. Part IV is Claims 1-9, all biographical. Confirmed.
2. The claim does place Erika Kirk at the meeting, at Tier 1. Complaint para. 1 verbatim: Snow "fed Owens a completely and obviously fabricated story that Brian Harpole met with Army intelligence officers and Erika Kirk, Charlie's now widow, at Fort Huachuca to plan the murder."
3. The library already HOLDS the Owens artifact and never inventoried it. "files - Bride of Charlie series/BOC-E08_transcript-artifacts/feed.xml" contains Ep 283, "What Does Ben Shapiro Know About Erika Kirk And Fort Huachuca?", pubDate Sat, 20 Dec 2025 — an on-disk, library-internal confirmation of the gap, seven months before the 2026-07-15 compile.

WHAT IS REFUTED:
A. THE ATTENDEE LIST IS WRONG AND WOULD NAME A SITTING CONGRESSMAN ON ONE SLOPPY SOURCE. Null battery on the complaint under two independent extractions (pdftotext -layout AND -raw), ligature-normalized, with patterns capable of matching: "Amodei" 0, "Amod" 0, "Secret Service" 0, "Secret" 0, "Nevada" 0, "Nev." 0 — against "Huachuca" 61 and "Congressman"/"congressman" 5. The complaint says Snow claimed he saw "a congressman walking out of Fort Huachuca with several people, including multiple 'high-ranking' military officials" — UNNAMED. Ligature normalization was load-bearing: "flight" returned a FALSE NULL (0) before it and 9 after, because the PDF uses U+FB02. Rep. Mark Amodei and the Secret Service member come solely from Just The News — the one outlet of the four that renders the subject "Erika Kirt" throughout. Volokh (which read and links the complaint) and Forbes both omit them; Forbes says only "senior government officials." Writing Amodei's name into the analyst layer as an alleged assassination-planning attendee, on a single secondary source contradicted by the primary, is a silent T1-via-T3 promotion and fails the inclusion test independently of recording-layer fidelity.
B. "ALREADY WRONG WHEN WRITTEN" IS FALSE. The Part III sentence sits in the "Legal posture" paragraph whose entire subject is Erika Kirk/TPUSA's cease-and-desist letters and their stated position that litigation "was not desired." Its evident referent is a suit BY Erika Kirk/TPUSA. Harpole is a different plaintiff and does not falsify it. Verifying in the other direction, I searched for any suit brought by Erika Kirk or TPUSA and found none — only the C&D letters. The null was correct in its scope on 2026-07-15 and remains correct on 2026-08-17. It is UNDER-SCOPED (states no search space, contrary to objectivity rule 3) — a real but far smaller defect. The finding's own proposed edit concedes this by rewriting it as "No suit brought *by* Erika Kirk or TPUSA": that fixes scope, not error.
C. "THE ONLY OWENS-ECOSYSTEM CLAIM ... THAT TOUCHES THE ASSASSINATION" IS FALSE AS STATED. The dossier already records assassination-touching claims about her three times: Part III (C&Ds asserting "murder-involvement and Epstein-trafficking claims are defamatory"), Claim 7 ("extended versions made her an Epstein 'recruiter' or implicated her in Charlie's death"), and Claim 8 (authenticity of the succession recording; her address condemning "the murder allegations"). Absent is the SPECIFIC Fort Huachuca allegation, not the category. The proposed edit's sentence "This is the only claim in this register that asserts anything about Erika Kirk's own conduct in relation to the killing" would inject a NEW false statement contradicted by Claim 7's own text.
D. THE "CONFLICTING FILING DATES" CAVEAT MANUFACTURES A DISCREPANCY. There is one filing date: 2026-04-30, stamped on all 69 pages, matching CourtListener dateFiled, Justia and PacerMonitor; Volokh wrote "just filed today" on 04-30. 05-01 and 05-05 are the Forbes and JTN PUBLICATION dates. This is the project's own metadata-is-not-content hazard in a new guise — a dateline is not a filing date. Relatedly, "PACER (M.D. Tenn.) retrieval is an open Tier 1 acquisition path" is already stale: the complaint is free on RECAP and I read it.
E. Minor: causes of action are six counts, not three (I Defamation; II Defamation re professional unfitness; III False light invasion of privacy; IV Defamation; V Civil conspiracy to defame; VI Aiding and abetting defamation). Defendants are four: Candace Owens, Candace Owens LLC, GeorgeTom Inc., Mitchell Snow — so Volokh's "Mitch Snow (not a defendant in this case)" is itself wrong, and "Owens' companies" resolves to the two named entities. "Flight data" is JTN's phrasing; the complaint pleads "flight records"/"travel logs" that Owens had access to and never produced.
F. STRUCTURAL: Part IV's stated schema is "Each entry: her claim/public narrative -> the challenge -> best assessment." A Claim 10 that is an accusation ABOUT her has no "her claim" leg. It belongs in Part III (legal posture) or a new part, not the "alleged lies" register.
G. The two ancillary assertions in the proposed edit DO check out but are sourced to none of the four cited URLs: Erika Kirk said "I have Candace Owens claiming I murdered my husband" (Charlie Kirk Show, ~April 2026) and Owens replied on X "of everything I've said about Erika, she chooses to respond to something I never said. They always lie."; the Snopes $40M ABC/"The View" debunk is real (origin: "America's Last Line of Defense" satire network).

I also logged a confirmation cutting against the omission framing: the library made an explicit, documented routing decision on this litigation — "files - Bride of Charlie series/BOC-ROUTE-2026-07-27_post-series-case-claims-corpus.md" section 6 item 4 marks "the Harpole litigation against Owens (331, 334)" as "Explicitly out of scope." That decision governs Owens-episode inventory, not the Erika dossier, so it does not defeat the gap — but the gap should be closed knowing the library previously routed this away on purpose.

On the rule itself: CLAUDE.md bars "home addresses" and "identifying information about uninvolved parties." ### (e) SHOULD EITHER FILE EXIST IN ITS CURRENT FORM?

**Arrest chronology — YES, but it must be re-scoped from a *sourcing memo* into an *evidence file*, and renamed.** Its structure is sound and its core narrative survived contact with the primary record (five confirmations logged across the lenses). But its organising premise is now false: it is built as a reconstruction *from reporting about documents the project could not read*, and the project now reads them. Concretely: §6 is titled a four-tier framework but is really an access-path apology; Tier 1 is populated by CNN and the Salt Lake Tribune; the whole file is a T1-via-T3 artifact that never uses the marking. Recommendation: keep the file, give it a File ID and §0/§1 per convention, promote the affidavit/Information/bail order/booking record to direct Tier 1, and **retitle §2's "Overnight transport" heading, which no longer describes anything the record supports.** Its sibling `tier1-acquisition-roadmap.md` is stale in at least five places (reader 1) and must be versioned in the same commit — it is the same age and the same commit as the target.

**Erika dossier — NO, not in its current form.** Three independent Q-138 lenses reached the scope problem from different directions, and the set evidence (C4, D5, D6) confirms it:
 - **The title announces the widening.** "Background, Family, and Contested-Claims Dossier" names three subjects; only the third is in Q-138's scope, and "Dossier" is the wrong register for a file about a bereaved protected person who is not a party or witness.
 - **The inclusion test has not been run once.** Part II carries a residential street name, a private sibling's paternity allegation, an aunt's approximate birth year and residence region, and a private ex-partner's engagement rumour — all faithful to their sources, all failing the inclusion test. The distinction the task names has never been applied to this file.
 - **It has no court-record spine at all** (C4), which is what Q-138 exists to add — but adding one to a file that is already 40 KB of genealogy will make the widening worse, not better.

Recommendation, as a queue item: **split it.** (1) A short, properly-headed evidence file on Erika Kirk's *role in this proceeding* — victim representative designation (dkt 12, granted orally 2025-12-11), protected person under the signed pretrial protective order (dkt 14), the 2026-01-16 Invocation and its F-84 deployment, the 2026-07-08 supplemental notice — role and relevance only. (2) A claims-inventory file on *the disinformation ecosystem*, which is what Part III/IV actually are and what line 186 correctly says the material is for, folded into the Owens index of D7. Parts II's genealogy survives only where it serves a logged claim. **Do not simply bolt the court record onto the existing file.**

**One correction to the recon that both target files depend on:** recon item 5 lists the 2025-12-04 UOVC restitution notice (dkt 211) as a "held primary bearing on Erika Kirk." Three readers opened it independently and it does not — its claimants are other victims, and nothing in it belongs in the dossier. That correction should reach the recon template, not just this report, or the next pass will chase it again.
